basic_info.description: Don't miss this exceptional top-floor condo on the North slope of Potrero, offering 1,400 sq ft of living space featuring 3 bedrooms and 1 bathroom. The expansive living areas are flooded with natural light and include original period details, hardwood floors and stunning downtown views. The bright eat-in kitchen, dining area and work nook provide a great space entertaining and relaxing. This sunny and popular neighborhood enjoys a stellar location with convenient access to amazing restaurants, shops, parks, and public transportation. Easy street parking and ample storage completes this amazing home.
